name: Baron Silverlaine
summary: Baron Silverlaine's spirit lingers in the Great Hall above Pyrewood Village. He once ruled Silverlaine Keep, until Archmage Arugal unleashed worgen upon the region and they slaughtered him.

sections.title: The Fall of Silverlaine Keep
sections.body: Baron Silverlaine ruled a noble estate in the southern hills of Silverpine. His fortress guarded the surrounding lands and kept them safe. That peace ended when Archmage Arugal summoned worgen to fight the rampaging Scourge and unleashed them upon the region. The feral beasts could not be controlled. They stormed the stronghold, overwhelmed its guards, and butchered the baron.

sections.title: A Tormented Specter
sections.body: Baron Silverlaine remains bound to the keep's ancient Great Hall. His restless ghost wanders among the wrecked dining tables where he once feasted. The cursed lord attacks intruders who enter his former home.

faq.answer: Baron Silverlaine ruled Silverlaine Keep, a fortress above Pyrewood Village. Worgen overran the fortress and killed him.

faq.q: Why is he haunting Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Worgen unleashed by Archmage Arugal slaughtered Silverlaine in his own home. Cursed in death, his ghost remains bound to the dining hall of his keep and cannot move on.
Silverlaine's cursed spirit remains in his former home, where he attacks trespassers in the Great Hall.

faq.q: Where in the keep can he be found?
faq.answer: Baron Silverlaine haunts the Great Hall, once the keep's lavish dining room, which was wrecked when his estate fell.

faq.q: What was Shadowfang Keep called before the worgen attack?
faq.answer: Before the worgen attack, the fortress was called Silverlaine Keep, after the baron's noble family, who ruled it before Arugal took control.

faq.q: Did anyone in Silverlaine's family survive?
faq.answer: No account says whether anyone in Silverlaine's family survived. The accounts tell of the worgen assault and the baron's ghost, but say nothing about the rest of his household.

angles.text: For a human, Silverlaine's fate marks the fall of human noble authority on Gilneas's borders. His keep fell to the reckless magic of a Dalaran-trained wizard.
For the Forsaken crossing Silverpine, Silverlaine's specter is another remnant of the old aristocracy to clear before they can break Arugal's hold on the keep.
For a mage, Silverlaine's fate warns of reckless magic. Archmage Arugal mishandled the summoner's art, destroying innocent lives and leaving lasting scars.
